investigation_notes.Description: A PowerShell command was executed by user t_doe on WKSTN-DEV-19 that ran Get-AuthenticodeSignature against C:\Users\t_doe\AppData\Local\Postman\app-10.21.0\Postman.exe and then base64-encoded the JSON output. The initiating process was Postman.exe (parent explorer.exe) with SHA256 145c75624d30ef5a088048904ac268d9bb24568df442cc8ab39bceb3cddbb24e, which returned no detections on VirusTotal; no external IPs were present and there are no recent related events or similar alerts. Given the legitimate binary, signature-checking behavior, clean reputation, normal parent process, and lack of historical alerts, this activity is assessed as Low Priority.
